gemini.title: Blpu
gemini.abstract: Blpu is part of AddressBase Premium, published by Ordnance Survey. It represents blpu features using geometry geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Ordnance Survey as part of AddressBase Premium. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: uprn
columns.description: Unique Property Reference Number identifying the addressable location.

columns.name: logical_status
columns.description: Code indicating the lifecycle status of the address record.

columns.name: blpu_state_date
columns.description: Date associated with the represented feature or source record.

columns.name: parent_uprn
columns.description: Unique Property Reference Number of the parent addressable location.

columns.name: x_coordinate
columns.description: X coordinate recorded for the address; coordinate units require the product documentation.

columns.description: Y coordinate recorded for the address; coordinate units require the product documentation.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude coordinate, normally expressed in decimal degrees.

columns.name: longitude

columns.name: local_custodian_code
columns.description: Code assigned by the source dataset.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Date associated with the represented feature or source record.

columns.name: last_update_date
columns.description: Date associated with the represented feature or source record.

columns.description: Date associated with the represented feature or source record.

columns.name: postcode_locator
